build_activation_layer_from_cfg: build an activation layer from a config dict using build_activation_layer
use_Clamp_activation: use the Clamp activation layer to clamp tensor values between a min and max bound
use_GELU_activation: use the GELU activation layer to apply Gaussian Error Linear Units to a tensor
use_SiLU_activation: use the SiLU activation layer to apply Sigmoid Weighted Linear Unit to a tensor
register_activation_modules: register built-in PyTorch activation modules like ReLU and Sigmoid into the ACTIVATION_LAYERS registry
